name: Wishlist grid
summary: Saved items in a two-column grid that widens on larger screens: product photos, price drops marked, a sold-out item, Move to bag and remove, and a slot that hints where the next saved item goes.
use: on a saved-items or wishlist tab of a shop
a11y: Move to bag is a toggle with aria-pressed and the sold-out one is disabled; each heart names the item it removes and moves focus on, changes are announced, and old prices are read as "was".

use_when: any saved-for-later list of products where price changes and stock matter
avoid_when: items the person is about to buy: use cart-drawer
browsing a shop's catalogue: use product-card
one product's photos and options: use product-gallery

parts.name: title
parts.what: the list's name, followed by the item count

parts.name: remove
parts.what: a filled heart that removes the item from saved

parts.name: name
parts.what: the product name, cut to one line

parts.name: price
parts.what: the price; after a drop, the old price struck through and a Price drop tag; or a back-in-stock date

parts.name: move
parts.what: Move to bag toggle; disabled and saying Sold out when out of stock

parts.name: slot
parts.what: a dashed box hinting where the next saved item goes

empty.how: removing every item leaves the count at 0 items and only the dashed 'Save more here' slot

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if moving to the bag fails, set the toggle back and show toast-stack with the reason

disabled.how: a sold-out item's button is greyed out, says Sold out and cannot be pressed

overflow.how: the grid has two columns, three from 40rem and four from 56rem; more items add rows

long_text.how: the product name is cut to one line; prices and tags wrap under each other; button labels never wrap

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab moves through Share list, then each item's remove heart and Move to bag; sold-out buttons are skipped
Enter or Space on Move to bag toggles it, and the change is read out
Enter or Space on a heart removes the item, reads out the change and moves focus to the next item's heart, or to Share list
